item.creatorsword.cogwheel_shield.toolti: Continuously increases the shield's rotation speed. Equipping a _backtank_ can consume air to _increase acceleration_.
Displays _RPM_ in the bottom-right corner of the screen.
When releasing the rotation key at 64 RPM or above
_Throws_ the shield, dealing _damage_ to creatures along its path. _Damage_ depends on _rotation speed_.
item.creatorsword.cny_creator_sword.tool: An ancient sword with wrench functionality.
Bulk _smokes_ targeted dropped items or materials on processing surfaces, consuming _1 durability_.
item.creatorsword.trial_creator_sword.to: A trial sword with wrench functionality.
Bulk _sandpaper-polishes_ targeted dropped items or materials on processing surfaces, consuming _1 durability_.
item.creatorsword.tidecrest_creator_swor: A lost sword with wrench functionality.
Bulk _washes_ targeted dropped items or materials on processing surfaces, consuming _1 durability_.
Store energy. Strike with the mace.
Store kinetic energy, then release to _dash forward_ and deal _smash attacks_ to targets along the path.
Bulk _presses_ dropped items or materials on processing surfaces and _compacts_ ingredients in basins, consuming _1 durability_.
item.creatorsword.frogport_grapple.toolt: _Pulls the creature towards you_. Holding a _Capture Box_ in your offhand allows you to _capture the creature_.
When hooked onto an Aeronautics physics structure
_Pulls you towards the structure_. _Sneak_ while standing on the ground to _pull the structure towards you_.
item.creatorsword.capture_box.tooltip.su: A box for _containing and transporting creatures_.
item.creatorsword.capture_box.tooltip.co: When right-clicking a block with a filled box
item.creatorsword.capture_box.tooltip.be: _Releases_ the captured creature and leaves an empty box.
item.creatorsword.capture_box.tooltip.co: When processing a filled box with Crushing Wheels
item.creatorsword.capture_box.tooltip.be: Grants _%sx_ loot rewards (%s independent loot table rolls). _Consumes_ the creature and Capture Box; no empty box is returned.
advancement.creatorsword.cogwheelshields: Hold a Cogwheel Shield spinning at 512 RPM in each hand at the same time.
Accumulate 100000 blocks of movement using the Frogport Grapple.
enchantment.creatorsword.pneumatic_boost:
Makes cogwheel shields spin up faster and flywheel maces charge faster.
When a backtank contains air, consumes it to further speed up these processes.
Increases the attack speed of creator's swords and flywheel maces.
When spinning up a cogwheel shield
Each level increases rotational acceleration by _5%%_; consuming backtank air adds another _10%%_ per level.
Each level increases charging speed by _30%%_; consuming backtank air adds another _15%%_ per level.
When holding a creator's sword or flywheel mace in the main hand
enchantment.creatorsword.relay_impact.to:
Briefly accelerates the flywheel mace after hitting a creature during a dash.
Allows a thrown Cogwheel Shield to pierce creatures and briefly accelerate.
When a flywheel mace dash hits a creature and deals damage
Each level adds _0.3 blocks per game tick_ to dash speed for _0.5 seconds_. Triggering again _refreshes the duration_ without stacking the speed bonus.
When a flying Cogwheel Shield hits a creature

The shield _pierces the creature_ and keeps flying instead of immediately returning. Each level adds _0.1 blocks per game tick_ to flight speed for _0.5 seconds_. Triggering again _refreshes the duration_ without stacking the speed bonus. Levels I/II/III also raise rotation speed to at least _64/128/256 RPM_. Higher existing rotation speed is preserved, and rotation speed continues to decay normally.
enchantment.creatorsword.inertial_charge: Increases the Flywheel Mace's charging speed and maximum energy capacity.
Each level increases charging speed and maximum energy capacity by _30%%_.
enchantment.creatorsword.overdrive.toolt:
Doubles the cogwheel shield's maximum rotation speed.
Doubles the flywheel mace's charge capacity.
Increases maximum rotation speed from _256 RPM_ to _512 RPM_.
_Doubles_ maximum energy capacity. Stacks with _Inertial Charge_.
enchantment.creatorsword.rebound.tooltip: Allows a thrown Cogwheel Shield to keep flying after colliding with a block.
When a flying Cogwheel Shield hits a block
The shield _bounces_ and keeps flying instead of immediately returning.
Prevents individual durability losses of up to _1 point per level_. Losses above this threshold apply _normally_.
enchantment.creatorsword.sticky_tongue.t: Increases the Frogport Grapple's creature capture level
When using the default target rules
Level I allows pulling _friendly creatures_ and some _neutral creatures_. Level II allows pulling some _monsters_.
Valid targets at each level are determined by the _server configuration_.
item.creatorsword.crimson_afterglow_smit: _An ancient forging plate engraved with the embers of sunset._ The sands buried the forge, yet could not carry away its last trace of warmth.
Obtained through _archaeology_ at _Trail Ruins_, _Desert Pyramids_, and _Desert Wells_.
item.creatorsword.trial_smithing_templat: _A cast copper token bearing the mark of trials._ Patina fills its grooves, yet where the blade once passed, the metal still gleams.
item.creatorsword.tidecrest_smithing_tem: _A relic from the seabed, etched with a tidal gear._ The tides wore away its inscription, yet the outlines of its gears remain.
Obtained through _archaeology_ at _cold ocean ruins_ and _warm ocean ruins_.
item.creatorsword.precision_trial_key.to: A more advanced Trial Key. It seems to slip past a certain restriction.
item.creatorsword.precision_ominous_tria: A more advanced Ominous Trial Key. It seems to slip past a certain restriction.
